class_bridges.basis: Robbery (120) and Burglary (220) offences -- the Incident Profile characterising the Crossover Heist -- correspond to the CLASSES of digital evidence collected in the case investigation (emails, files, URLs, disk images, registry keys, exhibits). This is a CLASS-level correspondence between the deployed Offence (NIBRS) and CaseObject (CASE) entities: those offence KINDS correspond to those evidence KINDS -- state it directly. It is not a per-record join: the products share no per-record key, so it never pairs a specific offence with a specific exhibit and no single figure spans both.

Policing Core.Agency.description: A law-enforcement agency that reports incidents to NIBRS, identified by its Originating Agency Identifier (ORI).

Policing Core.Arrestee.description: A person arrested in connection with an incident. Sourced one row per arrestee from the Arrestee segment.

Policing Core.Bias.description: A bias motivation behind an incident (the offender's bias against a victim group). NIBRS records up to five per offence; the extract carries the first offence's bias slots, surfaced here at incident grain.

Policing Core.CaseObject.description: A digital-evidence object in a CASE/UCO investigation graph -- the umbrella node that every typed artefact (email, file, URL) specialises. Source: the CASE_Source 'Object Node' entity.

Policing Core.ChainOfCustody.description: The chain-of-custody record for a piece of evidence -- exhibit number, acquisition time and the forensic action that acquired it (CASE ProvenanceRecord + InvestigativeAction).

Policing Core.EmailMessage.description: An email message recovered as digital evidence (UCO EmailMessageFacet); a specialisation of CaseObject.

Policing Core.File.description: A file recovered as digital evidence (UCO FileFacet); a specialisation of CaseObject.

Policing Core.Incident.description: A single reported criminal incident, the anchor of the crime area. One incident may carry up to three offences and any number of victims, offenders and arrestees.

Policing Core.Offence.description: An offence recorded within an incident. NIBRS holds up to three offences per incident in parallel numbered columns; each is one row here.

Policing Core.Offence_SuspectedOfUsing.description: Whether an offender was suspected of using alcohol, drugs or computer equipment on an offence. Computer equipment is the digital-involvement signal.

Policing Core.Offender.description: An offender recorded in an incident. May be anonymous (demographics unknown). Sourced one row per offender from the Offender segment.

Policing Core.Property.description: Property lost, stolen, recovered or otherwise involved in an incident. NIBRS records up to ten items per incident; the extract carries three item slots, each with its loss type, description, value and recovery date.

Policing Core.Url.description: A URL or domain name recovered as digital evidence (UCO URLFacet / DomainNameFacet); a specialisation of CaseObject.

Policing Core.Victim.description: A victim recorded in an incident - a person, business, financial institution, government, society or other. Sourced one row per victim from the Victim segment.

Policing Core.Weapon.description: A weapon or force used in an incident. NIBRS records up to three per offence; the extract carries the first offence's weapon slots, surfaced here at incident grain.
